title: Palisades Recreation Center – Donation of Tennis Court Improvements from the
text:
Palisades Recreation Center – Donation of Tennis Court Improvements from the
  Los Angeles Parks Foundation Through Funding Provided by the Live Like Braun
  Foundation, and Approval of Associated Recognition Signage and Naming of
  Court No. 1 in Honor of Braun Levi – Categorically Exempt from the Provisions
  of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Pursuant to Article 19,
  Section 15311 [Placement of Minor Structures Accessory to (Appurtenant to)
  Existing Commercial, Industrial, or Institutional Facilities] of California CEQA
  Guidelines as well as Article III, Section 1, Class 11(1) and Class 11(6) of City
  CEQA Guidelines
